label: Groove 52 ac
description: MikroTik Groove 52 ac (RBGrooveG-52HPacn) — 1x 1G RJ45, Wi-Fi 2.4/5 GHz. MIPSBE 1-core QCA9556.
notes: Power method from the mikrotik.com spec table: **PoE in: Passive PoE** (10-30 V) on `eth1`. Input is recorded on the first Ethernet port because the table states the method and voltage but does not name the port, and every MikroTik with a PoE-IN DC input takes it there. Max power consumption 5 W.
